en: The image shows a historical European square with a large ornate fountain at its center. The fountain is decorated with statues and surrounded by several people, some standing and some sitting on its steps. Around the square are multi-story buildings with green shutters and arched arcades at street level. The scene appears to be from an earlier period, possibly late 19th or early 20th century. The text at the top reads 'Trento. Piazza grande colla fontana.'
